audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 1 row gives the level to Camille while the content layer opens 'Level 1 is mine: Seismic Shard (Q) outranges everything Camille has'. The row and its own explanation disagree.
audit.why: Seismic Shard is 625 range with a move-speed steal; Precision Protocol is a 325-range auto-attack empower. Malphite genuinely wins the level-1 poke exchange, which is what the prose says.
audit.corrected: Could not be edited — see notes. Recorded for the user; the rest of the chart (Camille from 2 onward, Skill at 6) is correct.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Malphite level 1, Camille 2-3 on the Q proc and Tactical Sweep, Skill at 6, and Camille's takeover at 2+ items behind The Hextech Ultimatum (140s at rank 1). Both layers agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of the three interactions that decide this lane were absent: Adaptive Defenses only shields one damage type, and only the outer half of Tactical Sweep slows and heals her.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit on both. Adaptive Defenses shields her against the damage type she was hit by, and Malphite is one of the few champions who natively deals both — Thunderclap's empowered autos are physical, Ground Slam is magic damage based on his armour. Alternating them means the shield is always the wrong type. And Tactical Sweep only slows and heals in its outer half, so stepping into the cone instead of backing out of it denies her both.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, phases[3].why, dontsFull[0].d and content wants.you[0] and whys[1] now carry both interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Don't titled 'Fight near walls' had a body copy-pasted from the generic Granite Shield trade line and never explained the wall.
audit.why: Hookshot has to grab terrain to fire, so it is 16s of gap-close and knockup that simply does not exist in open lane. That makes where you stand a real lever, not a vague warning.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[2].d and dosFull[0].d around the terrain requirement and the 16s number.
